endpoint_qc.quarterly_value: arithmetic mean of complete UCMR4 samples at a site within a calendar quarter
endpoint_qc.warning: Research analogues only. UCMR4 is not Stage 2 compliance monitoring and HAA9 has no 60 ug/L MCL.

population_qc.duplicate_resolution: kept the row with the largest adjusted population, then largest retail population
population_qc.interpretation: Secondary complete-case sensitivity using EPA SYR4 system populations, not a population-complete UCMR4 estimate

equivalence_summary.cost_interpretation: Equal expected analytical budget, using system-specific observed sample counts and fractional randomization between adjacent integer HAA9 sample counts

negative_control_summary.interpretation: Exact same-size species-set sensitivity. Species are not exchangeable, so the rank is not a formal randomization p-value.

state_map_qc.mapping_rule: Only USPS codes for the 50 states and District of Columbia were retained. Numeric EPA regional or tribal codes and territories were not reassigned without a verified crosswalk.
